text: A fine, cold rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Began to fall. <break time="0.8s" /> And the wind grew stronger. <break time="0.8s" /> The man from the West. <break time="0.8s" /> Waited in the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> For about twenty minutes. <break time="0.8s" /> Then a tall man. <break time="0.8s" /> In a long overcoat. <break time="0.8s" /> Hurried across the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Toward him. <break time="0.8s" /> His coat collar. <break time="0.8s" /> Was turned up high. <break time="0.8s" /> All the way to his ears. <break time="0.8s" /> Is that you, Bob. <break time="0.8s" /> He asked doubtfully. <break time="0.8s" /> Is that you, Jimmy Wells. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the man in the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> The tall man took both of his hands. <break time="0.8s" /> It is Bob, sure as fate. <break time="0.8s" /> I was certain. <break time="0.8s" /> That I would find you here. <break time="0.8s" /> If you were still alive. <break time="0.8s" /> You have changed a lot, Jimmy. <break time="0.8s" /> I never thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That you were so tall. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, I grew a little. <break time="0.8s" /> After I was twenty. <break time="0.8s" /> Answered the tall man. <break time="0.8s" /> Are you doing well. <break time="0.8s" /> In New York, Jimmy. <break time="0.8s" /> Fairly well. <break time="0.8s" /> I have a job. <break time="0.8s" /> In one of the city departments. <break time="0.8s" /> The two men walked up the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Arm in arm. <break time="0.8s" /> And Bob began to talk proudly. <break time="0.8s" /> About his success.
